purpose: Broaden Stage 0 Aseprite/LibreSprite chunk coverage beyond tags/layers by proving Palette Chunk 0x2019 color semantics and Slice Chunk 0x2022 organ bounds in a deterministic three-frame, three-layer compressed RGBA subset, without claiming arbitrary schema coverage or live editor validation.

external_anchors.used_for: ASE Palette Chunk 0x2019, Slice Chunk 0x2022, Layer Chunk 0x2004, Tags Chunk 0x2018, User Data Chunk 0x2020, and compressed Cel Chunk 0x2005 layout.
Slice bounds and pivot semantics are treated as named regions, not as arbitrary Mechagotchi schema replacement.
LibreSprite remains a compatibility boundary; no GPL editor code is embedded.

limitations: Stage 0 Aseprite/LibreSprite palette/slice proof covers Palette Chunk 0x2019, semantic Slice Chunk 0x2022 bounds, three semantic layers, three frame tags, and compressed RGBA cels.
Live external editor rewrite validation is not verified by this lab.
Arbitrary Aseprite project schemas, tilemaps, tilesets, linked cels, nested groups, advanced timeline variants, and full project-format coverage remain separate.
